digest.component_or_area: MCP server factory and pydantic-settings integration
propositions: MCP v1.29.0 defines Settings before FastMCP under postponed annotations, leaving Settings.lifespan as an unresolved ForwardRef that is never rebuilt after FastMCP becomes available
On first FastMCP construction, pydantic-settings 2.15 detects the incomplete FieldInfo and emits IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning, which aborts build_server() when promoted to error
Calling Settings.model_rebuild() before FastMCP construction resolves the forward reference and prevents the warning without suppressing it or changing dependencies
The repair must be implemented at the lazy MCP import boundary in build_server() and verified via fresh-subprocess facade contract test to ensure first construction succeeds
